name: PursueCare
one_liner: Online addiction treatment with buprenorphine (Suboxone) or naltrexone, counseling and mental health care in nine Northeast and Midwest states.
best_for: Adults in its states who want buprenorphine (Suboxone) treatment from home
People on Medicaid who want addiction treatment by video
People who want counseling and mental health care alongside addiction medication

People who need medically supervised detox or inpatient care
People outside CT, KY, MA, ME, NH, NJ, OH, PA and WV
short_description: Telehealth medication treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorder, with counseling, in about nine states; takes Medicaid, Medicare and private insurance.
long_description: PursueCare is a telehealth addiction and mental health provider based in Connecticut. It offers medication for opioid use disorder (buprenorphine such as Suboxone or Subutex, and naltrexone such as Vivitrol), treatment for alcohol use, counseling, psychiatric care and case management by video through its app, with some in-person clinics. An October 2024 release listed nine states: CT, KY, MA, ME, NH, NJ, OH, PA and WV. It accepts Medicaid, Medicare and private insurance, and Medicaid patients should not receive a bill. Without insurance, its pricing page lists a $50 one-time new-patient evaluation and plans from $175 a month, with medication extra. It runs its own pharmacy, PursueCareRx, but you can use any pharmacy. PursueCare also owns the FDA-authorized RESET and RESET-O prescription apps, which are separate products. Medication for opioid use disorder is well studied, but no published study of PursueCare's own service was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance (Medicaid usually $0); self-pay $50 first evaluation, then plans from $175/month
pricing.notes: Accepts Medicaid, Medicare and private insurance. Self-pay medication is extra; extra sessions $60 each. Its FAQ also mentions self-pay from $50/session. Financial assistance and a Good Faith Estimate are available.

privacy.notes: The site's only 'Privacy Policy' link (read 2026-10-27) is a telehealth HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices: a sale of PHI needs your written authorization, but there is no website policy covering cookies or advertising and no deletion right.

faqs.a: PursueCare is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.
PursueCare pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.
Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Buprenorphine (Suboxone) treatment for opioid use disorder by video
Naltrexone (Vivitrol) for opioid or alcohol use disorder

patient_summary: You meet a PursueCare clinician by video, and if appropriate you are prescribed medication for opioid or alcohol use disorder such as Suboxone or Vivitrol, alongside counseling and case management. It accepts Medicaid, Medicare and private insurance; Medicaid patients usually get no bill. Without insurance there is a $50 first evaluation and plans from $175 a month, plus medication.

availability.note: Nine states per an October 2024 release (CT, KY, MA, ME, NH, NJ, OH, PA, WV); a 2023 release said 12, so confirm your state.
